title: How Inclusive Are Wikipedia’s Hyperlinks in Articles Covering Polarizing Topics?
reasoning: The paper evaluates the 'Neutral Point of View' policy of Wikipedia by auditing information exposure and bias in its hyperlink network. It specifically uses moral and religious polarizing topics as test cases, including Abortion (pro-life vs. pro-choice), Evolution (creationism), and LGBT rights, to measure whether the platform provides balanced access to different ethical and belief-based stances.
